row.name: borrowing_items_open_idx
row.where: returned_at IS NULL AND marked_lost_at IS NULL

row.name: items_serial_uq
row.where: "serial_number" IS NOT NULL AND "deleted_at" IS NULL

row.name: borrowing_events_movement_check
row.value:
(event_type IN ('issued', 'returned', 'marked_lost') AND movement_id IS NOT NULL)
				OR (event_type NOT IN ('issued', 'returned', 'marked_lost') AND movement_id IS NULL)

row.name: borrowing_items_condition_check
row.value: returned_condition IS NULL OR returned_condition IN ('good', 'damaged', 'incomplete')

row.name: borrowing_items_due_after_issue_check
row.value: due_at IS NULL OR issued_at IS NULL OR due_at > issued_at

row.name: borrowing_items_origin_storage_check
row.value: origin_storage_id IS NULL OR origin_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL

row.name: borrowing_requests_guest_id_type_check
row.value: guest_id_type IS NULL OR guest_id_type IN ('ktp', 'sim', 'passport', 'other')

row.name: borrowing_requests_borrower_identity_check
row.value:
(borrower_type = 'user' AND borrower_user_id IS NOT NULL AND borrower_customer_id IS NULL AND guest_name IS NULL AND guest_phone IS NULL AND guest_id_number IS NULL)
				OR (borrower_type = 'customer' AND borrower_customer_id IS NOT NULL AND borrower_user_id IS NULL AND guest_name IS NULL AND guest_phone IS NULL AND guest_id_number IS NULL)
				OR (borrower_type = 'guest' AND guest_name IS NOT NULL AND guest_phone IS NOT NULL AND guest_id_number IS NOT NULL AND borrower_user_id IS NULL AND borrower_customer_id IS NULL)

row.name: inventory_code_numberings_reset_check
row.value: reset_policy IS NULL OR reset_policy IN ('never', 'yearly', 'monthly')

row.name: inventory_documents_owner_check
row.value: (product_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id IS NULL) OR (product_id IS NULL AND item_id IS NOT NULL)

row.name: item_serials_warranty_check
row.value: warranty_expires_on IS NULL OR acquired_on IS NULL OR warranty_expires_on >= acquired_on

row.name: items_deactivation_reason_check
row.value: (status = 'inactive' AND deactivation_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'inactive' AND deactivation_reason IS NULL)

row.name: items_storage_requires_warehouse_check
row.value: storage_id IS NULL OR warehouse_id IS NOT NULL

row.name: movements_owner_check
row.value: (product_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id IS NULL) OR (product_id IS NULL AND item_id IS NOT NULL)

row.name: movements_transfer_target_check
row.value: (movement_type IN ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out') AND target_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL) OR (movement_type NOT IN ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out'))

row.name: movements_item_type_check
row.value: (movement_type IN ('borrow_out', 'borrow_return', 'project_site', 'disposal', 'lost') AND item_id IS NOT NULL) OR (movement_type NOT IN ('borrow_out', 'borrow_return', 'project_site', 'disposal', 'lost'))

row.name: stock_adjustments_approval_check
row.value: (status NOT IN ('approved', 'posted') OR (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL))
